claims.reason: parseFor refuses > and >= with the invert-the-index message (1320-1323), checks the condition and step name the loop variable (1315-1318, 1346-1349) and fails on exprIsFixed for the init and the limit (1303, 1330); moonlive.md says only that the counter is declared, nothing about counting up, the variable rule or a fixed bound.

kLayoutTemplate writes `for (y = 0; ...)` and `for (x = 0; ...)` (MoonLiveLayout.h:25-26), parseFor fails with 'a loop counter is declared: for (int i = 0; ...)' when `int` is absent (1286-1289), the test at 670-677 pins that message, and no test compiles the template; nothing in docs or comments names it.

emit_isa.cpp:70 names CompileResult::kStringPool while the struct declares only kMaxStrings (MoonLiveCompiler.h:60), every other user spells kMaxStrings, and disasm.py compiles emit_isa.cpp with c++ on every run (disasm.py:103-114), so the build step fails before any ISA is reached.

Both defaults are the bare `for (i = 0; ...)` loop (disasm.py:176, emit_isa.cpp:61); parseProgram refuses anything not opening with `class` (2005-2006) and parseFor refuses an undeclared counter (1286-1289), so the default never compiles.

asFunction ORs platform::codeAddressBits into the address (MoonLive.h:43); the constant is 1 on Teensy with the Thumb-state comment, 0 on desktop and ESP32, and the engine has no other Thumb spelling.

tick installs the canvas, fade and motion sinks, the pool sink when particles exist and the flow sink when a trail exists, and detaches all five at 139-146; setFadeSink's comment says fade from a layout or modifier reaches no sink; the pool and flow installs are conditional, which the claim glosses but does not contradict.

HeapAsm placement-news the assembler into platform::alloc memory because its tables put ~1 KB on the stack (lower.h:58-68), Staging heap-allocates the code buffer because 2 KB of stack overflowed the classic ESP32 (MoonLive.cpp:50-56), and asm_xtensa.h:26 states the overflow.

CtrlType::Json is a handle in an int's slot (Builtins.h:19-20), convertLiteral fails with 'only a service script has json documents' unless the table has a jsonReturn `json` builtin (594-607), scriptDoc resolves the handle through JsonFetch for the arena (service.h:91-99), and moonlive.md:309 states the handle-in-a-slot fact.
releaseIfEmpty releases only when every sink field is empty with the comment giving the early-release reason (233-240), and setAddLightSink clears first and releases last (369-375).

mm_light_fade forwards to the fade sink (546-553) which the effect points at Layer::fadeToBlackBy (Effect.h:97-100); fadeToBlackBy keeps the minimum amount (Layer.h:289) and Layer.h:154-157 consumes fadeBy_ once per frame, so the smallest amount, the longest trail, wins.

parseCondition branches each conjunction to lFalse, allocates one lNext label per || term and none for && (1629-1658), and moonlive.md#branching states that evaluation stops at the first deciding side.

guardDepth is ir.hasScriptCall() (lower.h:82), flushGuard emits one guard per function after guardPending is set by the parking, closeFn binds fnExit then tooDeep and emits the single decrement before the epilogue (106-130), with kDepthSlot and kMaxCallDepth in Builtins.h:184-188.

The static_assert half is right (asm_xtensa.cpp:116-122), but kXtReg maps R6..R9 to a8..a11, which call8 rotates out, and call() and callLabel() save and restore them around every call (asm_xtensa.cpp:199, 451-457, 476); the contract.md:34-36 sentence the claim repeats is stale against the map, and the cited lines do not show the save.
compile() const_casts and script_ is mutable (Layout.h:124-129, 154), and the architecture page's paragraph on applyState preparing parent-before-child states the reason verbatim.
SysVarTable::add refuses an Arena offset below kCtrlBytes, at or past kDepthSlot or off a 4-byte boundary, and an Arg register above 4, with the past-the-arena comment (228-240).

alloc pops freeStack before taking a fresh vreg and freeTemp pushes a consumed temp (497-510) under the tree-walk register stack comment, with the multi-call and sequential-loop tests at the cited lines.

offsetOf(Coord3D) returns bytes outside the grid and offsetOf(index) bytes past the end, writeAt and readAt return early when off plus the channel width passes bytes, and the comment at draw.h:82 states the by-coordinate and by-index pairing.
resizeBytes returns on bytes == bytes_ and memsets only after a fresh alloc (ScratchBuffer.cpp:22-31); GEQEffect::prepare and GameOfLife both memset after resize with comments naming that reason.
audioDrive returns kOne without a frame, 0 below kSilence = 8, and kOne/4 plus the band share otherwise, each with the cited comment (particles.h:91-103).
runEffectOnGrid pins the clock at 100000 and 100016 ms and ticks twice, with the two-tick and red-channel-probe comments at gridsweep.cpp:47 and 61.

applyDmx sets lastUniverse_ from frameMax_ when the first universe arrives, marks the frame done when the last one went missing (frameDone = !frameShown_) or at universe >= lastUniverse_, with the comment at 138 stating the rule.

ScratchBufferBase's constructor registers with the owner (ScratchBuffer.cpp:12-14), MoonModule::release walks the list calling resizeBytes(0), and applyState calls prepare or release by effectivelyEnabled (MoonModule.h:92-109).
The 'Why the box is clipped' comment (draw.h:22-29) gives the r-squared cost, the INT16_MAX wrap and the inclusive-walk reason for emptying both ends, and clipBox at 990-992 does exactly that.
Sprite's comment names index 0 as the transparent key and vertical frame stacking, sprite() clamps frame to frames-1 and flips sx0 on the read with the same-footprint comment (677-692).
MoonModule::setStatus stores the pointer (status_ = msg, MoonModule.h:468), and both DemoReelEffect.h:166 and NetworkReceiveEffect.h:181 keep a member buffer with a comment saying so.

BeatPhase accumulates dt*rate in a uint64 and divides by 60000 in phase() (math16.h:197-207) with the nine-copies comment, WaveEffect uses it, and the doc's 'Effects must animate at every tick rate' rule states the truncation and the fix.
Canvas::of applies d > 0 ? d : 1 once (draw.h:63-67), and power-functions.md:61-65 states the mismatch argument, the sixteen depthDim() copies and the by-value register measurement.

FixedPointEffect.h:74 says fadeToBlackBy is a rate per reference frame, Layer.h:288 says every amount is a rate and a blank buffer is draw::fill, and the robustness-rules paragraph gives the 255 discontinuity on the fade sliders.
